ValidationRule.description: Prevents Concert records where City is New York and Concert Date falls in December, January, or February.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(City__c, "New York"), OR( MONTH(Concert_Date__c) = 12, MONTH(Concert_Date__c) = 1, MONTH(Concert_Date__c) = 2 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The New York venue is closed during December, January, and February. Please select a different date or city.
